metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin collection with 19 specialized plugins

plugins.name: github-dev
plugins.description: GitHub workflow: commit, PR, issue, worktree, unified CodeRabbit + ChatGPT-Codex cr-fix pipeline (wait + auto-fetch + apply + push loop with branch-protection-gated auto-merge, CR-engagement guard, Codex review-id discovery + dedupe with grace polling, CR Nitpick + Codex P3 silent skip, optional --skip-minor opt-in for Minor + Codex P2 suppression), project tracking, release

plugins.name: code-scout
plugins.description: Boilerplate and ML resource discovery. Portable tools first (gh CLI, curl + HF REST, uvx hf); Python wrappers carry PEP 723 inline deps so `uv run <abs>` works from any cwd.

plugins.name: ml-toolkit
plugins.description: GPU parallel processing, Gradio CV apps, CV notebook generation, interactive CV data exploration

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns from text

plugins.name: paper-search-tools
plugins.description: Academic paper search (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, etc.)

plugins.name: docs-forge
plugins.description: README/CHANGELOG generation with CRO best practices

plugins.name: slidev
plugins.description: Slidev markdown presentation generator with interview workflow and KubeCon-level visual enhancement

plugins.name: workflow-viz
plugins.description: System workflow Mermaid diagrams and ASCII progress tracking

plugins.name: rules-forge
plugins.description: CLAUDE.md generation and .claude/rules/ modular structure with auto mode detection (NEW/TIGHTEN/SPLIT/REORGANIZE), single write-rules skill entrypoint

plugins.name: tcrei-prompt
plugins.description: Rewrite prompts using Google's TCREI structure for next-session reuse

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Sync my-claude-plugins skills, commands, and subagents to Codex (~/.agents/skills/ for skills+commands, ~/.codex/agents/*.toml for subagents — USER scope) so they become callable as native $skill-name / subagent. Body-only transform with bridge_source provenance marker.
